owner: DelegatedCheckoutApi over existing native preview, receipt and intent owners
authentication: Existing opaque customer bearer, current native resource ownership and contact/source proof; loopback-only with exact host/origin checks. No remote delegate/OAuth/DPoP qualification.
input_policy: Exact JSON object keys; IDs reference original native owners. No authority/trust/context/quote provisioning, verification flags, URLs or snapshots are accepted.

response.result: Original native preview or intent view, or this contract

configuration: Actual kernel-bound owners are injected only by server construction. Missing live owners preserve current-proof retained-status reads and cancellation. No rehydrated preview or persisted evidence recreates live provenance.
privacy: Responses are no-store. The bounded compact JWS exists transiently in request/verifier memory and is never logged or persisted; retained evidence uses the existing intent privacy lifecycle. Status/code logs omit bodies, credentials and identifiers. Memory zeroization is not claimed.
effects: Native local preview and intent operations only; no provider call, challenge consumption, operation queue, merchant dispatch, order or payment effect.
retry: No automatic transport retry. Exact receipt retry returns retained history; a changed token conflicts. An ambiguous HTTP response does not imply failure; explicitly read the original intent status. Preview creation has no idempotent transport retry contract.
